CAPSIMG - FS-UAE Windows builds

IPF decoding for OptiMiyoo's HxC converter.
Project: SPS Decoder Library, adapted by Frode Solheim for FS-UAE.
Repository: https://github.com/FrodeSolheim/capsimg
Published plugins: https://fs-uae.net/plugins/
